title: Repair Estimates & Appointments Lot Billing: Amount of a Storage Statement Charge
content:
**Clause.** For a vehicle left at a center after a Repair Estimates & Appointments teardown estimate, the free storage days run from the estimate written date as day zero and are counted as calendar days. The first billed day of a storage statement is the day after the last free storage day and its last billed day is the statement date, both days included. The storage statement charge is the billed days times the storage daily rate, rounded to the cent once on the final figure. The standard free storage days are the estimate type's free storage days and the standard storage daily rate is the estimate type's daily storage rate, as the lot storage tariff of each estimate type states them.

**The quantities, defined**

| Quantity | Definition | Read from |
|---|---|---|
| Day zero | The estimate written date | The booking record |
| Free storage days | The calendar days after day zero, as many as the estimate type's free storage days | The estimate type's tariff |
| First billed day | The day after the last free storage day | Derived |
| Last billed day | The statement date | The date the statement is posted |
| Billed days | Every calendar day from the first billed day to the last billed day, both included | Derived |
| Charge | Billed days multiplied by the storage daily rate, rounded to the cent once, on the final figure | Derived |

**Worked figure** (hypothetical inputs chosen for illustration — 3 free storage days and a daily rate of 60.00 USD, not tariff values):

- Estimate written on 2 March (day zero). Free storage days: 3, 4 and 5 March.
- First billed day: 6 March. Statement date: 15 March, the last billed day.
- Billed days: 6 March to 15 March, both included — 10 days.
- Charge: 10 multiplied by 60.00 USD, 600.00 USD.

**Boundary.** A statement dated on or before the last free storage day has no billed day and therefore no amount to bill; a statement dated on the first billed day bills exactly 1 day.
